demo_banner: DEMO DATA MODE ACTIVE — ALL DATA IS REGISTRATION TEST DATA
diagnosis_subtitle: Universal Multi-Model Crop Disease Intelligence System for Indian agriculture. Screen leaf photographs across Specialist models for Cotton, Wheat, Rice, and Chilli alongside Horticultural Benchmark networks with explainable differential diagnostics.
diagnosis_dropzone_prompt: Click to browse or drag & drop leaf photo
diagnosis_dropzone_hint: Take a clear close-up photo of the affected leaf in good natural light. Avoid blurred or distant canopy shots.
diagnosis_notes_placeholder: e.g. Yellow lesions appearing on lower leaves after rain
diagnosis_awaiting_desc: Select a photo of a crop leaf and click Analyze Crop Leaf. The classifier will screen for 38 benchmark crop diseases and healthy leaf conditions.
diagnosis_supported_crops_list: Apple, Blueberry, Cherry, Corn (Maize), Grape, Orange, Peach, Bell Pepper, Potato, Raspberry, Soybean, Squash, Strawberry, Tomato.
diagnosis_cotton_unsupported_title: Cotton Not Supported by this Benchmark Model
diagnosis_cotton_unsupported_desc: The PlantVillage 38-class diagnostic model is trained on 14 specific horticultural and cereal crops and does NOT include Cotton. SmartFarm AI enforces strict safety boundaries and will not generate a fabricated diagnosis for cotton leaves. Please consult your local district cotton extension officer or CIRCOT.
diagnosis_screening_hint: Pre-processing resolution, evaluating foliage color ratio, and running inference...
diagnosis_chemical_warning: Warning: Always use personal protective equipment (PPE). Never spray chemical fungicides during peak pollinator hours. Adhere strictly to the pre-harvest interval (PHI).
diagnosis_when_to_consult: When to Consult an Agricultural Expert / KVK
diagnosis_disclaimer_text: This feature provides AI-based visual pattern screening. It does not replace on-field physical inspection, laboratory soil/tissue pathology testing, or certified agronomic advice. Never apply chemical pesticides solely based on an AI screening. Always consult your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or State Agricultural University extension officer.
diagnosis_history_empty: No previous leaf diagnoses saved yet.
diagnosis_err_blur: Image appears blurry or out of focus. Please capture a sharp, well-lit close-up photo.
diagnosis_err_non_leaf: Non-crop foliage detected. The uploaded photo does not contain sufficient green leaf tissue.
diagnosis_err_unsupported: The selected crop is not supported by this diagnostic model.
moisture_subtitle: Real-time root-zone soil moisture monitoring, sensor status, and agronomic irrigation triggers.
moisture_sensor_notice: No physical capacitive soil probe connected for this field. Real-time sensor charts require hardware pairing. You can log manual measurements or reference regional data.
irrigation_subtitle: Log field water applications, track irrigation history, and review smart water requirement recommendations.
irrigation_volume_hint: Leave blank if water meter is unavailable. Volume is never fabricated.
irrigation_notes_placeholder: e.g. Applied soluble fertilizer with drip, ran morning shift
irrigation_history_empty: No irrigation events recorded yet for this field.
status_offline_desc: Displaying cached data. Real-time updates will resume once connection is restored.
status_demo_banner_desc: Simulated data is being presented. Physical hardware telemetry or live farmer records are never contaminated.
status_ai_unvalidated_lang: AI advice generated in this language is an automated translation and has not been field-validated by agronomists.
status_map_unavailable: Map tiles currently unavailable. Coordinates listed below.
diagnosis_cotton_specialist_desc: Specialist EfficientNet-B2 neural network trained on ICAR-CICR cotton leaf blight, bacterial blight, grey mildew, and leaf curl virus classes.
diagnosis_wheat_specialist_desc: ResNet-50 architecture trained on CIMMYT and ICAR-IIWBR wheat yellow rust, brown rust, stem rust, and powdery mildew classes.
diagnosis_rice_specialist_desc: ViT-Small architecture trained on IRRI and ICAR-NRRI rice blast, bacterial leaf blight, brown spot, and sheath blight classes.
diagnosis_validation_desc: Specialist diagnostic weights for this crop are undergoing multi-season field validation with State Agricultural Universities. Below are verified regional symptoms and ICAR prevention guidelines.
diagnosis_feedback_thanks: Thank you! Your feedback has been recorded to improve model precision.
